# MPay Cultural Voucher WooCommerce Gateway

> WooCommerce payment gateway plugin for MPay Cultural Voucher payments in Moldova.

## Overview

This WordPress plugin integrates WooCommerce stores with the MPay payment system for Cultural Voucher transactions. It handles the full payment lifecycle: redirect to MPay, SOAP callbacks (GetOrderDetails, ConfirmOrderPayment), WS-Security XML signature verification and signing, and order status management.

## Architecture

- Payment flow: customer clicks Pay, store generates HTTP POST form redirecting to MPay with ServiceID and OrderKey, MPay calls back the store SOAP endpoint
- SOAP server receives GetOrderDetails (returns order amount, description) and ConfirmOrderPayment (marks order paid)
- WS-Security: incoming SOAP requests are signature-verified using MPay public certificate; outgoing responses are signed with the store PKCS#12 private key
- Certificate formats: PKCS#12 (.pfx/.p12), read via PHP OpenSSL or CLI fallback
- Idempotent confirmation: transient-based locking prevents double-processing

## Key Files

- mpay-voucher-gateway.php: main plugin file, autoloader, activation hooks
- includes/Woo/Gateway_MPay.php: WC_Payment_Gateway subclass
- includes/Core/Rewrites.php: endpoint registration, HTTP POST redirect form
- includes/Soap/Server.php: SOAP callback handler
- includes/Soap/WsSecurity.php: WS-Security sign and verify
- includes/Core/OrderMapper.php: order data mapping and payment confirmation
- includes/functions-helpers.php: settings, profiles, certificate utilities
- includes/Admin/Settings.php: admin settings page with tabs

## Requirements

- WordPress 5.8+
- WooCommerce 6.0+
- PHP 7.4+ with OpenSSL and SOAP extensions
- Valid PKCS#12 certificate (from STISC for production, or MPay-provided for test)

## Documentation

- docs/en/ - English documentation (15 files)
- docs/ro/ - Romanian documentation (15 files)
